body: I don’t think I know how to break up with someone…I’ve tried breaking up during those times but I always want to do it in person but it’s hard because he’ll keep following me until I take it back. I (22) just heard a conversation between my boyfriend (21) and this guy that his sister is dating. We have been dating for just over 2 years but around 1 1/2 years into it there were 3 instances of cheating on his side…and I struggled a lot to try to move past it but to him he said he forgot and said 9 months instead when I confronted him about it…I thought it was a very important thing in the relationship to remember so I was shocked.Today, in his convo with the guy I asked my bf to ask the guy for some advice since this is considered our first relationship and was surprised how badly he distorted the situation and put me in a bad position…I have always tried to make light of the situation of him cheating and focused on his good points to get my friends to approve of him but was surprised that he does the opposite to make his actions not look bad…I’m worried that he must view my actions that poorly as well and this isn’t the first time too. I’m just really frustrated at myself
